# ZIP producer fixtures

Generated on 2026-11-02. These archives contain the same three authored files:

- `report/SKILL.md`: `---\nname: report\ndescription: Writes reports.\n---\nReport instructions.\n`
- `report/run.sh`, mode 0755: `#!/bin/sh\necho report\n`
- `report/café.txt` (NFC), mode 0644: `non-ASCII filename\n`

`SKILL.md` is mode 0644 for filesystem producers. Python's default writestr
metadata uses mode 0600 without Unix type bits; its script explicitly uses
`ZipInfo.external_attr = 0o755 << 16`. JSZip entries use `unixPermissions` 0644
and 0755 without explicit type bits. File permissions other than the owner
execute bit are not retained by publication.

| File | Actual producer | Generation |
|---|---|---|
| infozip-default.zip | Info-ZIP 3.0, Linux | `zip -r infozip-default.zip report` with default extra fields |
| python-writestr.zip | Python 3.12.3 zipfile, Linux | `ZipFile(..., 'w').writestr('report/'+name, bytes)`; script uses the ZipInfo above |
| jszip-unix.zip | JSZip 3.10.1, Node, Linux | `zip.file(path, bytes, {unixPermissions: mode})`; `generateAsync({type:'nodebuffer', platform:'UNIX'})` |
| macos-ditto.zip | `/usr/bin/ditto`, native arm64 macOS 27.0.1 | Extract Python fixture with `unzip`, `chmod 755 report/run.sh`, then `ditto -c -k --keepParent report macos-ditto.zip` |
| 7zip.zip | 7-Zip 23.01, Linux (Ubuntu package 23.01+dfsg-11) | `7z a -tzip 7zip.zip report` |

The native ditto fixture stores valid UTF-8 filename bytes without setting the
UTF-8 flag. Readers that assume CP437 from that flag alone may display the name
incorrectly; the Engine validates the raw UTF-8 bytes. This fixture has no
resource-fork sidecars. NFD names and `__MACOSX` roots have explicit negative
cases elsewhere; this is not a claim that every archive produced by ditto is a
valid Skill package.

Go FileInfoHeader archives and synthetic Windows metadata are generated by tests.
No regeneration tool is a test-time dependency. Content and executable behavior
are asserted after parsing and through the HTTP publishing boundary.
